title: Demo tenant provisioning automation (bootstrap + reset) with idempotency and guardrails
creator: Devon Price
body:
## Context
SEs/AEs need a reliable, repeatable demo environment (“demo tenant”) with a one-command bootstrap/reset flow. Today, demo setup is tribal knowledge and brittle: missing projects/routes, auth/RBAC mismatches, quota settings drift, model pins change, and Console dashboards are empty.

This ticket implements the core provisioning automation that can:
1) create/verify the demo org + projects + routes + prompt sets + evals scaffolding
2) reset state between demos quickly (minutes)
3) be safe (guardrails) and idempotent (re-runnable without manual cleanup)

Primary users:
- Sales Engineering (Markus Klein + SE team)
- DevEx (Alex Martinez / Monica Patel) for demo code + SDK pinning
- SRE/Eng Platform for keeping the env healthy

## Goals / outcomes
- **One command** to bootstrap the demo tenant from a known config.
- **One command** to reset the tenant to a known-good baseline (without breaking parallel demos).
- **Idempotent**: running bootstrap/reset multiple times yields same end state.
- **Guardrails**: cannot target non-demo tenants; requires explicit confirmation and environment checks.
- **Fast**: reset < 10 minutes with clear progress + pass/fail summary.
- **Auditable**: actions write to audit logs with a dedicated “demo-automation” actor.

## Non-goals
- Building a new UI inside Console (“demo mode” toggle).
- Fully automating enterprise screenshots/backup mode capture (tracked separately).
- Making demo tenant usable as customer POC (explicitly out of scope).

## Proposed solution
### 1) Internal CLI: `redwood admin demo-tenant`
Commands (initial set):
- `bootstrap` — create/verify demo org, projects, routes, quotas/rate limits baseline, and seed config
- `reset` — return demo tenant to baseline state (truncate demo-only resources, rotate demo keys if requested)
- `status` — output current health + drift summary

Where possible, commands should call existing control-plane APIs; any missing API surface should be added behind internal auth.

### 2) Source of truth for demo tenant config
- Store a **versioned JSON seed definition** in repo (same PR as CLI).
- Include:
  - org + project names/IDs (if created)
  - route definitions (pinned models handled by ENG-4840)
  - baseline quotas and rate limits
  - prompt sets + eval harness pointers
  - synthetic usage presets (hooks to traffic generator)

### 3) Reset semantics
Reset must be safe and deterministic:
- Delete/truncate demo-only datasets (prompt runs, eval runs, synthetic events older than N days)
- Re-create routes/projects that drifted
- Re-apply baseline quotas + rate limits
- Optionally rotate demo keys (default: rotate weekly; manual flag for “rotate now”)
- Kick off synthetic traffic generator job so dashboards are non-empty within ~5–10 min

### 4) Guardrails
- Hard-check tenant/org matches allowlist (e.g., org slug prefix `demo-`, account tag `purpose=demo`).
- Require a `--confirm DEMO_RESET` style explicit confirmation.
- Require internal auth + membership in `sales-engineering` or `demo-admins` RBAC group.
- Emit structured logs + audit events for every mutation.

### 5) Observability & runbook alignment
- `status` should include:
  - model pin availability (delegated to ENG-4840/healthcheck)
  - quota headroom
  - Console ingestion freshness (are synthetic events flowing)
  - last reset time + actor

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] `bootstrap` creates demo org/projects/routes and can be re-run with no errors and no duplicates.
- [x] `reset` completes in < 10 minutes in normal conditions and outputs a final summary.
- [x] `reset` fails closed (no-op) when org does not match demo allowlist.
- [x] Actions appear in audit logs under a dedicated automation actor.
- [x] SE runbook updated with exact commands + troubleshooting.
- [x] Dry run performed with Markus + at least 2 AEs; feedback addressed.

## Implementation plan
1) Add seed config format + validation (schema checks; friendly errors).
2) Implement `bootstrap` flow:
   - create org if missing (or verify)
   - create projects (`demo-hosted`, `demo-econ`, `demo-reliability`, `demo-observability`, `demo-security`)
   - create routes + apply baseline settings
3) Implement `reset` flow:
   - confirm guardrails
   - delete demo-only generated resources
   - re-apply baseline settings
   - optionally rotate keys / regenerate scoped keys
   - trigger synthetic traffic job
4) Add `status` flow:
   - drift detection (diff current state vs seed config)
   - output health summary
5) Add CI smoke test in staging demo env (limited, non-destructive; focuses on idempotency + allowlist enforcement).

## Rollout plan
- Phase 0 (internal-only): enable CLI behind feature flag `demoTenantAdminCLI`.
- Phase 1 (SE pilots): grant `demo-admins` to SE leads; use for all internal dry runs.
- Phase 2 (wider GTM): train all SEs; document in Confluence runbook; add Slack alias for failures.
- Phase 3 (hard requirement): starting 2025-12, “certified demo” requires using reset/healthcheck outputs.

## Risks / edge cases
- Parallel demos: reset must not blow away another SE’s in-progress demo. Mitigation: per-demo namespaces/projects tracked in ENG-4894; until then, enforce “only reset your assigned project” in CLI.
- Quota/rate limit drift: CLI should re-apply baseline on every run.
- API surface gaps: may need internal endpoints for bulk delete / seed apply; keep minimal and internal.

## Notes from field pain
- SUP-4127: 429 throttling during live demo (quota defaults too tight)
- SUP-4189: dashboards not populating (synthetic traffic not running / ingestion checks missing)
- INT-993: RBAC misconfigured (SE access blocked) — ensure role mapping is part of bootstrap verification
comments: 2025-10-14 (Devon Price): Drafted approach: internal CLI + seed config in repo; focusing on idempotency + hard guardrails so we don’t brick non-demo tenants.

2025-10-18 (Ethan Park): +1 to CLI approach. Please ensure all mutations go through control-plane APIs so audit logging is consistent; avoid direct DB writes. Also require an allowlist check (org tag).
2025-10-22 (Markus Klein): Biggest ask from SEs is “reset and know it worked.” Output needs to be obvious: green/red checks (keys valid, routes exist, dashboards will populate).

2025-10-28 (Sean Gallagher): Add a safety rail: rate limit reset itself, and add a “dry-run” mode that prints what would be deleted. Also ensure reset doesn’t run while synthetic traffic job is mid-flight (or it should handle it).
2025-11-04 (Devon Price): Opened PR-28451 with `bootstrap` + config validation; idempotency tested against existing demo org. Next up: reset semantics + confirmation flow.
2025-11-12 (Naomi Feldman): Please confirm demo data is synthetic-only and that reset does not touch any external connectors. Also document how keys are scoped and rotated (tie into ENG-4855).

2025-11-19 (Devon Price): Added allowlist + `--confirm DEMO_RESET` prompt; wired audit events to automation actor. `reset` now re-applies quotas/rate limits baseline and triggers synthetic traffic preset.
2025-11-26 (Allison Grant): Requested `status` include ingestion freshness and last synthetic traffic run time. This will help #sales triage “empty dashboards” fast.
2025-12-02 (Devon Price): Landed PR-28691 for reset safety rails + reset rate limits. Markus did a full run-through; timing ~6m end-to-end including synthetic traffic trigger.
2025-12-10 (Devon Price): Marking Done. Runbook updated + SE pilot complete. Remaining work for parallel demo isolation tracked in ENG-4894.
